g.text: i'm hazey. i build backend things in python, break them, and
write about it. this is my corner of the internet — click a tool
on the left to move around.
[2026-09-02] why my rust tcp server ate 4gb of ram
[2026-08-19] i switched to hyprland and lost a weekend
name, sound toggle, palette swap, search
every page is a "tool" · theme, hit counter, spotify
only this swaps between pages — the frame never moves
context filters for the active tool (tags, shelf state, years)
reacts to the page you're on
